To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Ohio Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Suspect Name:  Joshua Bays
Title of Case:  2025 Bus Stop Fatal Shooting Arrest and Interview
Date of Incident:  Aug 14 2025
City & State: Columbus, Ohio
Request: Arresting officers' body-worn camera footage for the arrest and interrogation/transport of suspect Joshua Bays in connection with the August 14, 2025 shooting incident near W. Broad Street and Wisconsin Avenue.
Link of Articles: https://prosecutor.franklincountyohio.gov/Community-Outreach/Newsroom/2026/10-7-Joshua-Bays-Pleads-Guilty-Sentenced#:~:text=Both%20counts%20included%20firearm%20specifications.%20Yesterday%2C%20Judge,Avenue%20on%20the%20report%20of%20a%20shooting., https://prosecutor.franklincountyohio.gov/Community-Outreach/Newsroom/2026/10-7-Joshua-Bays-Pleads-Guilty-Sentenced#:~:text=Both%20counts%20included%20firearm%20specifications.%20Yesterday%2C%20Judge,Avenue%20on%20the%20report%20of%20a%20shooting.

Any minor or uninvolved party appearances are omitted. Graphic, explicit, or sensitive content is blurred, redacted, or removed. Any other legally necessary redactions are made at your discretion. 
Preferred Format: Please provide the responsive records in digital format.

Thank you for your time and dedication to public transparency. If you have any questions or need additional information to fulfill this request, feel free to contact me. I look forward to your response.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Bartholomew Cubbins

title: Building, code enforcement and tank records for 800 Phillips Road (Xerox), Webster NY (C11-D14-R04)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records of the Village of Webster for one property: 800 Phillips Road, Webster, NY 14580 (Monroe County tax map parcels 065.19-1-1.1 and 065.19-1-1./IDA), the Xerox Corporation Webster campus; the owner of record of parcel 065.19-1-1.1 is Xerox Corporation (book 3379, page 408). The Village's Application for Access to Records is attached.

We are trying to establish what was stored, used and discharged at this property, because per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) have been found in the Monroe County Water Authority public water supply. Please search by the street address and tax map parcels as well as by these names: Xerox Corporation, Xerox Joseph C. Wilson Center for Technology, and any other past or present occupant of 800 Phillips Road.

On November 19, 2026 the Town of Webster answered our FOIL request 2026-616 and told us that 800 Phillips Road is within the boundaries of the Village of Webster for building records. We already hold the Town Fire Marshal's records for the campus (fire and hazardous materials incident reports 1993 to 2011, tank permits and removals 1989 to 2021, the 1995 Building 200 spill, the Tier I chemical storage notification and the 2003 hazardous materials violation), so please do not send copies of those. Before writing, I searched the Village website; I found no building, code enforcement or permit records for this property online.

For 800 Phillips Road only, from the earliest year held to the present, please provide:
1. Building records: building and demolition permits, certificates of occupancy or compliance, and change-of-use records for the buildings on the campus, and any tenant or occupancy listings.
2. Fire prevention and code enforcement records held by the Building Department: fire safety inspection reports under the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code, operating permits for hazardous materials and flammable or combustible liquids, violation notices and related correspondence.
3. Fire suppression system records for any sprinkler or foam systems at the campus (permits, plans, acceptance tests, inspection reports), and any record of aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) storage, use, testing or discharge at the campus.
4. Underground and aboveground storage tank (UST / AST) installation, removal and closure permits and inspection records.
5. Planning Board and Zoning Board of Appeals site plan, special use and variance files for the campus.
6. Any Village sewer-use or industrial wastewater discharge permit, sampling result or notice of violation for Xerox's discharge, if the Village sewer system serves any part of the campus.

If any of these records are held by another office, such as the Northeast Joint Fire District, please let me know which office to contact.

(Our reference: C11-D14-R04.)

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Vlad Gaylun
